text: Security is essential in web development. When you build a website, you must protect both your users and your data. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt the connection between the browser and the server. Second, implement strong authentication so that only the right people can access accounts. Third, validate all user input to stop harmful code from entering your system. Many common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, happen because developers ignore these steps. By following these basic practices, you can reduce risks and create a safer experience for everyone.
